title: ADR-0012 amendment: the push channel's relay transport, and vendor as a token type rather than a plugin boundary (ruling cloud#3519)
body:
Blocked-by: objectstack-ai/objectstack#29816

## Context

objectstack-ai/cloud#3519 was ruled **1C 2A 3A 4B 5A 6B 7B** on 2026-11-03. The store-published app pushes through a hosted relay in objectstack-ai/cloud. In phase 2, that relay also fronts the mainland-China vendor channels (HMS/Honor, Xiaomi, OPPO, vivo). ADR-0012 still says the domestic vendors are alternate channel plugins (§6, Non-Goals), and its §4 table lists only APNs/FCM as the push backend.

## Ask

One PR on `docs/adr/0012-notification-platform.md`. It is a governed path, so the maintainer merges it by hand.

- **§4:** the `push` backend becomes `relay (hosted, default) | direct (APNs/FCM, white-label)`.
- **§6:** the relay fronts the domestic vendors. `vendor` on a device row is a token-type discriminator that the relay routes on, not a plugin boundary. The `PushVendorSchema` widening still lands together with the transports, as `push-config.zod.ts` requires.
- **Non-Goals:** rewrite them to match.
- **Privacy:** the relay never receives plaintext content. Phase 1 is ID-only; phase 2 is end-to-end encryption with a device key.
- **Air-gap:** no system push; the in-app inbox only.
- **Supersession:** record which earlier wording this amends, and cite #3519.

## Acceptance

The ADR text matches the spec shape from objectstack-ai/objectstack#29816 and the ruling. There are no code changes.
